column1: # Decodo proxy pool for Spain citaconsular.es scanner
# DC proxies (dc.decodo.com) have been removed because Cloudflare recognises them
# as "trusted" IPs and issues cf_clearance in <3 s (fast-track). The JSD oneshot
# that follows returns a phantom cookie (CF says "already valid — no new clearance")
# causing /main/ to return 0 B on every solve attempt.
# Fix: leave this file empty so spain-decodo-pool.ts falls back to DECODO_PROXY_URL
# (ISP residential proxy). ISP IPs are unknown to CF → full JSD challenge (~10-40 s)
# → real cf_clearance → /main/ returns the expected 124 KB HTML body.
# To add dedicated ISP or residential IP entries
